hero.headline: Fashion for Everyone, Special Bouquets for Every Moment
hero.subtitle: Discover a diverse selection of clothing for all ages and styles, alongside custom flower bouquets crafted to your wishes. Explore our collection, find inspiration, and visit the Galeri Tik store to see our products in person.

features.qualityDesc: A wide variety of attire available for all ages, styles, and needs. Find the perfect collection for everyday activities or special occasions.
features.bouquetDesc: Bring your ideal bouquet to life with customizable themes, colors, and items tailored to your needs and budget.
features.fittingDesc: A simple fitting room is available to help you try on clothes and ensure a comfortable fit before buying.
features.paymentDesc: Enjoy easy payment methods available in store, ranging from Cash, QRIS, to direct bank transfer.

bouquetEducation.title: About Custom Bouquet Price Flexibility
bouquetEducation.desc: Every bouquet is uniquely handcrafted to order. You are free to determine your preferred colors, flowers, cash amounts, and decorative accents.
bouquetEducation.quote: Price estimates depend on complexity, flower/paper materials, and the denomination/number of money folds.
